findings.text: blocking: the budget-hold dry-run refusal is emitted with dry_run: True but without _with_resolved_overrides, so on a --set-carrying dry run that hits a budget hold a caller still cannot tell an override that resolved from one that never applied -- the exact defect section 7 exists to remove; the node's done-when ("every dry-run refusal document ... carries ... the override echo") is therefore not met.

follow-on: the plan-unavailable dry-run refusal carries the echo but omits dry_run: true; the same holds for plan-review-missing (reckon/cli.py:1809) and the competence-limit refusal (reckon/cli.py:1817). The comment at :1803 says these deliberately reuse the launching path's document shape, so this may be by design, but the done-when's literal text requires dry_run: true on every dry-run refusal document and these are emitted on the dry-run path.
